scientific_integrity: The universal theorem is proved by scalar minimization and the weighted spectral theorem. Exact rational matrices provide reproducibility checks but do not prove the infinite family by sampling.
scientific_limitations: Controls diagonal coefficients for finite irreducible reversible generators only, not all entries, internal stages, nonlinear problems or nonreversible dynamics. The published literature comparison is not exhaustive; independent mathematical audit has not occurred.
title: Sharp Radau IIA return-coefficient envelope and the eleven-state boundary
